messages.author: 1e82ea932416652e
messages.subject: Re: Text Menu in R Console
parts:
James,

Did you also install the DeducerText library and load DeducerText after loading Deducer? Are you loading Deducer in JGR rather than the CRAN R GUI?

My normal workflow, after installing JGR, Deducer and DeducerText, would be

> library(JGR)
> JGR()

After JGR launches, I'd now be working in JGR:

> library(Deducer)
> library(DeducerText)

At this point, all the expected menus should show up in JGR.

If you could provide the steps needed reproduce the problem, we might be more successful at diagnosing the problem.

- Tom

—

Thanks a lot for your support.
I got clue from  http://www.r-statistics.com/2012/08/how-to-load-the-rjava-package-after-the-error-java_home-cannot-be-determined-from-the-registry/ 

Finally It worked for me.
The Problem is i think JRE Version. By default Java is provided 32 bit version for JRE But My system is 64 Bit.
I have manually downloaded 64 bit version of JRE from Java website . After that all works well... I followed below Tom's steps for Loading 

My R version is 3.0.1  and now its working fine.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
